CustomField.formula:
IF(CONTAINS(SBQQ__PriceBook__r.Name , "EMEA") , "EMEA & APAC" , IF(AND(CONTAINS( SBQQ__PriceBook__r.Name , "Canada"), CONTAINS(SBQQ__Opportunity2__r.Owner.Level_4__c , "GHE")) , "GHE", IF(CONTAINS(SBQQ__PriceBook__r.Name , "Canada") , "US&Canada" , IF(OR(CONTAINS( SBQQ__PriceBook__r.Name , "Asia"), CONTAINS( SBQQ__PriceBook__r.Name , "Japan")) , "Japan" ,
"None"))))
CustomField.inlineHelpText: EMEA & APAC = If Pricebook is EMEA & APAC US & Canada = If Pricebook is US & Canada Japan = If Pricebook is Asia GHE = if Pricbook is US & Canada AND Opp Owner Level 4 region is GHE
